evidence: Follow Copland Track to Welcome Flat Hut via Architect Creek Hut.
The suspension bridge near Welcome Flat Hut leads across to the true left of the Copland River and onto a series of extensive grassy river flats.

Eventually you will reach the swing-bridge across Tekano Creek and the views to the upper valley will open out in front of you. Douglas Rock Hut (eight bunks) is nestled in a forest glade just across the bridge.

The route continues to sidle until directly below Copland Pass, at which point it zigzags its way up the steep slopes into an alpine basin.
The route ends at the alpine basin.

doubts: The page does not say how the walk returns (no 'return' in DOC's time '3 days +'), so shape and kind are left unclear; crossing Copland Pass is strongly discouraged, so it is presumably walked back, but the text does not say so. The start is just 'Car park' with no road-end feature in the packet, so its ref is null. I took Douglas Rock Hut as the main way's end (the last timed leg) and the marked route above it to the alpine basin as a second way; the page could also be read as ending at the alpine basin. Total time/distance for each way is not given (legs are 7 hr/18 km and 3 hr/7 km).
